analysis.title: Life after the squeeze (what the monster squeeze didn't fix)
key_insights: SPX moved from extreme oversold to major resistance in one session. The 7350-7400 area is big resistance with the 200-day MA there, and the longer-term trend sits near 7200 (cash levels).
BTIG: in 42 prior instances since 1985 of NDX rallying 6%+ while closing below its 200-day MA, the median 30-day return was -5.35% and the market was higher only 39% of the time.
NDX futures remain well below the 200-day MA with the short-term descending trendline intact, and the rally has not even reclaimed the 21-day MA.

S&P E-mini open interest rose $36.6bn from Nov 17 to 20 as the index fell 5.9%, with Friday's $26.6bn the biggest single-day change of 2026 outside roll periods. Monday's squeeze cut open interest only $7.9bn, implying fresh longs, lingering bears, or both.

AI debate unresolved: UBS notes focus has shifted from AI spend scale to returns. Expect differentiation between self-funded AI investors and debt-dependent names, so the next phase is dispersion rather than beta.
Bernstein's 66-stock, nine-sector analysis shows data center exposure explains about 45% of valuation compression. Memory and server OEMs saw the biggest dislocations while networking held up better.

SNDK trades at 2.5x forward earnings vs a three-year average of 10.4x, a 76% compression, almost twice what Bernstein's model implies. Technically it is deeply oversold, more than halved since October, with the 50-day about to cross below the 200-day. The desk is starting to pay attention as a contrarian.
GS: Asia positioning is much less crowded after aggressive de-grossing and a substantial drop in momentum exposure, leaving less excess if the rebound extends.
GS favors Nikkei outperformance call spreads (NT ratio) to play recovery toward October levels and an AI comeback in Japan without needing outright market direction.
Gold is trading unusually far below its 200-day MA, flagged as a contrarian setup.

Tether held an estimated 146.5 tonnes of gold as of June (WGC), which would rank it seventh largest if classed as a gold ETF. SocGen estimates about 65% of inflows into Tether's gold products may be new money.
DXY posted its biggest down candle in a while as it nears the descending trendline in place since mid-2023, and it is stretched vs its 200-day MA, suggesting a dollar pause.

tension_points.bull_case: Open interest fell only $7.9bn on Monday's squeeze, so shorts may not be cleared and there could be fuel left. Asia positioning is also less crowded.
tension_points.bear_case: SPX is at major resistance near the 200-day, and NDX is below its 200-day and 21-day MAs. BTIG analogs show a median -5.35% over 30 days.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A failure to clear SPX 7350-7400 resistance, or NDX staying below its 200-day MA with the descending trendline intact.
